trust_decision.summary: When a user with CONFIGURE on a project saves a 'Build other projects' trigger, AbstractProject.submit must require Item.BUILD on every named downstream project; the check resolved names under the caller's auth, so downstream projects the caller cannot READ were silently dropped from the check while still being stored and later triggered by the SYSTEM-built dependency graph.

landing_point.why: The 'execute arbitrary jobs' summary plus the SECURITY-55 BUILD check on BuildTrigger publishers in AbstractProject.submit is the obvious place; BuildTrigger.java:322-348 (doCheck form validation) is the other first stop.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /job/<name>/configSubmit (Job.doConfigSubmit -> AbstractProject.submit); also reached via Project/MatrixProject/MavenModuleSet submit overrides calling super.submit

O3_reason_to_dismiss: config.xml POST / CLI update-job / create-job / copy are 'raw XML admin paths' that never had the SECURITY-55 check and are guarded by CONFIGURE/CREATE, so a solver can argue the report is only about the web configure form.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Saving a project whose BuildTrigger names a downstream the user can READ and BUILD must still succeed; and the pseudo-upstream trigger conversion legitimately runs as SYSTEM to edit other projects' triggers. An over-broad fix (e.g. rejecting any unresolvable name, or making getChildProjects/fromNameList always run as SYSTEM) breaks name-tolerant configs referencing not-yet-created jobs or leaks hidden jobs through UI lists.

O6_input_shapes: comma-separated childProjects string with a downstream the caller cannot READ (the fixed case)
downstream the caller can READ but not BUILD (already covered by SECURITY-55)

O7_producer.where: core/src/main/java/hudson/tasks/BuildTrigger.java:299-307 (DescriptorImpl.newInstance builds the trigger from form JSON); name resolution in core/src/main/java/hudson/tasks/BuildTrigger.java:147-149

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /job/<name>/config.xml stores a BuildTrigger via XStream unmarshal with only CONFIGURE checked, no downstream BUILD check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Raw XML upload is an admin/API path, never covered by the configure-form check the report describes.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different class (AbstractItem) from the fix site, same package; check would sit in updateByXml at core/src/main/java/hudson/model/AbstractItem.java:568-594

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI update-job feeds stdin into updateByXml, same missing downstream BUILD check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: CLI is a separate legacy interface; previous commit (SECURITY-108) only checked job names on CLI create.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: hudson.cli package, two hops from the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: createItem with XML body / CLI create-job loads a new project whose BuildTrigger names any downstream; only CREATE checked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Creating a job is a different permission (CREATE) and a neighbouring feature, not 'configuring' a trigger.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: createItem mode=copy / CLI copy-job copies a source config including its BuildTrigger without checking BUILD on the downstreams for the copier
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Copy only duplicates an existing, already-approved configuration.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: pseudo-upstream 'Build after other projects are built' resolves upstream names under caller auth and then edits those projects' BuildTriggers as SYSTEM without a permission check on them
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the mirror feature of the fixed check in the same method family and already uses ACL.impersonate(ACL.SYSTEM), so a maintainer could add a BUILD/CONFIGURE check on resolved names only and repeat the visibility gap.

O9_family: missing/incomplete authorization (CWE-862/863) - permission check bypassed because name resolution is filtered by caller visibility

O10_build.toolchain: Maven 3, JDK 6/7 era (Jenkins 1.55x), HtmlUnit-based HudsonTestCase in test/ module

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap getChildProjects in ACL.impersonate(ACL.SYSTEM) inside submit only (the published fix), leaving config.xml / CLI / create / copy routes unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: core/src/main/java/hudson/model/AbstractProject.java:777-831 convertUpstreamBuildTrigger rewrites other projects' BuildTriggers as SYSTEM with no CONFIGURE check on those projects (different protection).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); Jenkins core tree is likely well within 5 MB-1.5 GB.
present_in_latest for all O8 routes: no latest release supplied.

Whether downstream builds are actually scheduled for an unreadable project via the stored trigger was inferred from DependencyGraph.build running as SYSTEM (core/src/main/java/hudson/model/DependencyGraph.java:84-89), not executed.
Advisory text itself was not provided beyond the summary; trust decision derived from the fix commit message and diff.
